09-4.solution: Tripling means interest of \(2P\) in \(8\) years, so the rate is \(\frac{2 \times 100}{8} = 25\%\) a year. To become \(6P\) the interest must be \(5P\): time \(= \frac{5 \times 100}{25} = 20\) years.

09-29.solution: Interest \(= 3993 - 3000 = 993\) over \(3\frac{3}{12} = 3.25\) years. \(R = \frac{993 \times 100}{3000 \times 3.25} = 10.18\%\), which is \(10.2\%\) to one decimal place.
